decisions.statement: A record is found by the provider that record names.
A collection stating no record of that provider answers with nothing.
A field the record leaves out answers with nothing rather than with empty text.
A value that is no list of records is read as no record at all.
A fresh record writes over the record the same provider held.
A fresh record leaves every other provider's record as that record was.
Records are ordered by the provider each one names.
Nothing here reads the index or a page's body.

definition: what one provider calls a collection, read off and folded into its records
